sacrilegiousness.definition: n. profaneness by virtue of committing sacrilege

sacrilegist.translation: 渎神者, 亵渎圣物者

sacrilegus.translation: [法] 犯橇门入教堂行窃罪者

sacring.translation: n. 弥撒圣别式, 圣别式

sacrist.definition:
n. A sacristan; also, a person retained in a cathedral to
   copy out music for the choir, and take care of the books.
sacrist.translation: n. 圣器保管人, 教堂司事

sacristan.definition: n an officer of the church who is in charge of sacred objects

sacristans.definition:
plural of sacristan
n an officer of the church who is in charge of sacred objects
sacristans.translation: (sacristan 的复数) n. 教堂司事

sacristies.translation: n. （天主教教堂里）圣器收藏室, 圣器安置所( sacristy的名词复数 )

sacrists.definition:
plural of sacrist
n. A sacristan; also, a person retained in a cathedral to
   copy out music for the choir, and take care of the books.
sacrists.translation: (sacrist 的复数) n. 圣器保管人, 教堂司事

sacristy.definition: n a room in a church where sacred vessels and vestments are kept or meetings are held
sacristy.translation: n. 圣器收藏室, 圣器安置所

sacro.translation: abbr. Scottish Association for the Care and Resettlement of Offenders 苏格兰罪犯照料和再定居协会

sacro-.definition:
A combining form denoting connection with, or relation to,
   the sacrum, as in sacro-coccygeal, sacro-iliac, sacrosciatic.

sacroiliac.translation:
a. 骶髂的
n. 骶髂关节病

sacrosanctity.translation: n. 神圣不可侵犯, 至圣

sacrosciatic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to both the sacrum and the hip; as,
   the sacrosciatic foramina formed by the sacrosciatic ligaments which
   connect the sacrum and the hip bone.

sacrovertebral.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the sacrum and that part of the
   vertebral column immediately anterior to it; as, the sacrovertebral
   angle.

sacrum.definition: n. wedge-shaped bone consisting of five fused vertebrae forming the posterior part of the pelvis; its base connects with the lowest lumbar vertebra and its tip with the coccyx

sacrums.translation: 荐骨, 骶骨( sacrum的名词复数 )

sacs.definition:
n. pl. A tribe of Indians, which, together with the Foxes,
   formerly occupied the region about Green Bay, Wisconsin.
sacs.translation: n. （动植物组织中的）液囊( sac的名词复数 )

sacu.translation: abbr. Society for Anglo-Chinese Understanding 英中了解协会
